name: Army of the Black Dragon
summary: In Brackenwall Village, the Army of the Black Dragon has left Tharg grieving and thirsting for vengeance. He blames Overlord Mok'Morokk for ordering the ogres to flee.

sections.title: A Grievance of Blood
sections.body: Black dragons killed Tharg's wife along with many ogres. After Rexxar made Mok'Morokk Overlord, the new leader ordered the survivors to run until they reached Brackenwall Village. Tharg says ogres are poor at running and should fight instead. He believes Mok'Morokk thinks only of himself, though Mok'Morokk now tells all ogres to stay put and keep Brackenwall Village safe.

sections.title: Home in the South
sections.body: Tharg calls the Stonemaul Ruins his home and likes the south. Brackenwall Village is no home to him. He wants revenge on the black dragon army and a return to the ruins, so he asks you to cut down Firemane Scouts and Firemane Ash Tails among its ranks.

faq.answer: Tharg is an ogre living in Brackenwall Village. Black dragons killed his wife, and he seeks revenge and a return to the Stonemaul Ruins.

faq.q: Why does Tharg dislike Overlord Mok'Morokk?
faq.answer: Rexxar made Mok'Morokk Overlord, but Tharg believes he cares more for himself than for the ogres. When black dragons killed many ogres, Mok'Morokk ordered the survivors to run. Tharg believes ogres should fight.
Black dragons killed Tharg's wife along with many other ogres. Her death fuels his wish for revenge.

faq.q: Where is the ogres' old home?
faq.answer: Tharg calls the Stonemaul Ruins his home and likes the south. Brackenwall Village is not home to him, and he wants to return to the ruins.

faq.q: Which enemies make up the army of the black dragon?
aliases: who to kill army of black dragon
faq.answer: Tharg points you toward the Firemane, including Firemane Scouts and Firemane Ash Tails.
